title: Posting Groups controlled setup decision after read-only preflight
purpose: Decide the smallest safe setup route for Universaarl posting groups after TARGET-028 proved current page contexts, without writing setup values in this decision case.

learnedPageRoutes.correction: TARGET-028 screenshot QA replaced the old wrong Page 93 assumption.

learnedPageRoutes.page: USt-Buchungsmatrix / VAT Posting Setup read-only boundary

entryCriteria: TARGET-028 observed the required posting-group setup pages read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No setup value, master data, draft, Preview Posting or Posting was executed by TARGET-028.
Vendor Posting Groups route must use Page 111, not the old Page 93 assumption.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision names which posting-group setup value family is next, or parks it with a clear reason.
The decision does not write any setup values.
The decision keeps VAT matrix correctness, master data, Preview Posting and Posting locked until separate cases unlock them.
The decision includes a lookahead card for the next 3-5 foundation steps.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-028 proved the current read-only page context for General Posting Setup Page 314, Customer Posting Groups Page 110, Vendor Posting Groups Page 111, Inventory Posting Setup Page 5826 and VAT Posting Setup Page 472. It did not prove setup completeness, account correctness, Preview Posting or posting readiness.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Dimensions remain important, but posting groups are still a blocking foundation dependency before master data and any posting preview. The smallest safe next effective action is a single Vendor Posting Group write gate using the already observed Page 111 route and the already visible SKR04 payables account 3300.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Page 111 is verified and account 3300 is visible as the payables account candidate. The case can be narrowly gated and should not touch other posting setup families.
Receivables mapping must be confirmed again before a Debitorenbuchungsgruppe is written.
General Posting Setup requires General Business and General Product Posting Groups plus sales/purchase accounts, not just Page 314 visibility.
Dimensions can resume after the first posting-group write gate is completed or blocked with evidence.
The checkpoint needs posting groups, VAT boundary and dimension status before master data can start.

queueChangesMade: Replaced the previously planned TARGET-030-DIMENSIONS-RECOVERY-DEFAULTS with TARGET-030-POSTING-GROUPS-VENDOR-INLAND-WRITE-GATE as the next active case.
Shifted Dimensions Recovery to a later lookahead slot after the first bounded posting-group setup write gate.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It is the smallest useful setup write: one verified page, one posting group row, one already proven payables account, no master data, no VAT matrix, no Preview Posting and no posting.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not create customer/vendor/item master data in the posting group write case.
Do not edit Customer Posting Groups, General Posting Setup, Inventory Posting Setup or VAT Posting Setup from the vendor posting group case.
Do not treat account 3300 as tax-advisor-final; it is a Universaarl starter SKR04 lab account.
Abort if Page 111 does not show Kreditorenbuchungsgruppen or Verbindlichkeiten-Konto.
requiredPreparation: Reconfirm Page 111 route and empty/current row context before any edit.
Use screenshot QA before and after the write attempt.
Persist only if Code, Description and Verbindlichkeiten-Konto are visible after reopen.
